conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 111 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 51 | 700 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.8 | 4.4 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
